title: Sub-stoichiometric 5-methoxyuridine modification enables tunable immune evasion and protein expression from synthetic mRNAs.
snippet: mRNA therapeutics depend on nucleotide modification to evade innate immunity and sustain translation. Current clinical designs replace all uridine with N1-methylpseudouridine (m1Ψ).
